Color hint Optional

Choose a block color (keys 1–8; 0 for Any). Paint adds tinted voxels; Color changes an existing voxel. Any removes the constraint.

Paint P · Erase E · Color C. Drag to neighboring voxels only. Right-click erases; right-drag or Alt-drag orbits. Middle-click paints the selected color; scroll to change colors. ← / → browse solutions. Ctrl/Cmd + scroll zooms.

Placing tutorial

Choose a shape from the library, press 1–8, or scroll the wheel to cycle blocks. Ctrl/Cmd + scroll zooms. Point at the floor or another block to preview where it snaps, then click to place. Blocks automatically rise above occupied spaces.

W / S or ↑ / ↓ tilt · A / D or ← / → turn · Q / E rotate the third axis. Right-drag to orbit (including below the floor); scroll to zoom.

Switch to Edit and click a block. Drag the colored axis arrows to move it, or select Rotate and drag the colored rings. Press G to move and R to rotate; H toggles the selected block gray; V toggles modes.

Construction from image

Import a Quadravox image to automatically find its 3D construction, or generate an editable starting model from visible block colors. Unknown or hidden geometry may need your adjustments.

Choose an imagePNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP
Images stay on your device. Imported images are not uploaded.

Automatic reconstruction is experimental. Exact recovered or previously saved puzzle images can load their known 3D structures. New colored images produce an approximate, connected arrangement of visible pieces; hidden voxels and their orientations cannot be recovered with certainty from one view.
